Sharada
 Psi Shivale, Shahu Nagar Police Station, Mumbai is present.
Digitally signed by

Sharada Rangnath
Wahule

Date: 2026.03.31
16:56:59 +0530
 Coram : Ashwin D. Bhobe, J.
DATED : 30th MARCH 2026

P.C.:
1. Heard Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant and Mrs. Rajeshri Newton,
learned APP for the Respondent-State.
2.

By the present Application, the applicant herein/ accused seeking to quash & set the FIR bearing Crime No.357 of 2024 registered under Sections 123, 214, 223, 276 of Bhartiya Nyay Sanhita 2023 with Section 59, 26(2)(iv), 26(2), 3(1)(zz)(iv), 30(2)(a), 27(2)(a), 27(3)(d) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 registered with ShahuNagar Police Station, Brihanmumbai City on 26th October, 2024 and charges sheet therein.
Sharada 3-APL-543-2026.doc 3.
Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the issue involved in the present Application is pending for consideration before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.

He further submits that similar issues are involved in Criminal Writ Petition Nos.280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs The State Of Maharashtra on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136403696/
1 and 4078 of 2025.

entities.text: Criminal Writ Petition Nos.280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Tanaji Nathu Khopade vs The State Of Maharashtra
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He refers to the orders passed in the above said Petitions, wherein this Court has admitted the same and granted interim reliefs.

4. Mrs. Rajeshri Newton, learned APP for the Respondent-State does not dispute that the issue involved in the present Application is subject matter of the Petitions, referred by the Applicant in the present Application.

She submits that the present Applicant filed under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short "BNSS") be tagged along with the aforesaid Petitions and other connected matters.
5. Mr. Tuushar Sonawane, learned Advocate for the Applicant submits that the interim orders granted in the aforesaid Petitions, be also granted in this Application.
6. Mrs. Rajeshri Newton, learned APP for the Respondent-State does not object to the said request.
Sharada 3-APL-543-2026.doc 7.
In view of the above, further proceedings in a case bearing Police Case PW/1119/2025 pending before the Court of City Sessions Court, Mumbai are stayed qua the Applicant.

sentences.text: 8. Tag this Application along with Criminal Writ Petition No.280 of 2025, 3444 of 2025 and 4078 of 2025.
